# `company.inventory_count_entries`

Append-only entries of a physical count; each counter writes their own.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this entry. |
| `count_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with count_id + ordinal | — | inventory_counts.id | Count this entry was made on. |
| `line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_inventory_count_entries_line | inventory_count_lines.id | Count line this entry counts. |
| `ordinal` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with count_id + ordinal | ix_inventory_count_entries_line | — | Order of this entry within its count, from 1. |
| `mode` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | set (the quantity at the place is this) or add (this many more). |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Quantity entered, base micro-units. |
| `scanned_code` | VARCHAR(128) | yes | — | — | — | — | Barcode the entry was scanned from; null when typed. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this entry was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this entry. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this entry. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this entry. |
